select SEQNO,busiDate,startTime,endTime,status,detailAction,taskCname,lastTime from ( SELECT LOG.SEQNO,DATE_FORMAT(LOG.BUSI_DATE,'yyyyMMdd') busiDate,LOG.START_TIME startTime,LOG.END_TIME endTime ,if(LOG.STATUS='02',if(IFNULL(logDetail.ERROR,0)=0,'02','09'),LOG.STATUS) status ,if(LOG.STATUS='02',if(IFNULL(logDetail.ERROR,0)=0,concat_ws('','执行成功',IFNULL(logDetail.success,0),'条','执行成功',IFNULL(logDetail.success,0),'条,失败',IFNULL(logDetail.ERROR,0),'条')),LOG.DETAIL_ACTION) detailAction1 ,ta.TASK_NAME taskCname,ROUND(LOG.LAST_TIME/1000,2) lastTime ,LOG.EXEC_RESULT detailAction FROM VAL_INTERF_ACTIONLOG LOG left join VAL_INTERF_TASK ta on ta.BEAN_NAME=LOG.TASK_ENAME LEFT JOIN( SELECT a.parent_seqno,sum(a.success) success,sum(a.ERROR) ERROR FROM ( SELECT parent_seqno parent_seqno, if(VAL.IS_CHECK='Y',LENGHT, null) success,if(VAL.IS_CHECK='N',LENGHT,null) ERROR from ( SELECT parent_seqno,IS_CHECK,COUNT(1) LENGHT FROM VAL_INTERFLOG WHERE 1=1 group by parent_seqno,IS_CHECK) val) a group by parent_seqno
) logDetail ON LOG.Seqno=logDetail.parent_seqno WHERE 1=1
AND LOG.EXECTASK_SEQNO = #{execId} ) logdetail WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY busiDate
